_note: Seeded 2026-08-21 with the one goal the existing objective seeds actually imply. AST009 is the real programme the two seeded objectives were distilled from (atom-spec §4); the outcome and its measure below are stated as `status: example` because no client has ratified them. A real engagement replaces this file with the client's own outcomes — the SCHEMA is shared core, these INSTANCES are per-project content.

goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.label: Product safety information reaching the company is recognised and reported within the required window, without relying on individual vigilance.
goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.measure: Proportion of inbound PSI-bearing contacts that are reported inside the regulatory window, and the count of late or missed reports found on audit.

reachability.trainable: Recognition. Staff who encounter a contact cannot report what they do not identify as product safety information in the first place — that is a knowledge and discrimination problem, and it is the part instruction can move.
not_trainable: Reporting channel friction — if the intake path is slow or unclear, trained staff still report late. Process, not instruction.
Workload and staffing — recognition under time pressure degrades regardless of how well someone was taught.
Incentive structure — where reporting is perceived to create work or risk for the reporter, training does not overcome it.
reachability.rationale: The two seeded objectives (define PSI, recognise PSI) both sit squarely on the recognition half. Naming the other three causes explicitly keeps a later audit from reading a flat reporting rate as a training failure — which is the failure mode this gate exists to prevent.

goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.derived_from: AST009 reference programme; the outcome implied by atom-spec §4's objectives, made explicit here for the first time.
